default_period.description: Default time period for metrics and reports when the user does not specify one.

sla_threshold_hours.description: Hours before an unanswered conversation is considered SLA-breaching. Used by inbox-triage, escalation-manager, and sla-monitor.

auto_assign.description: Whether skills should suggest automatic assignment of unassigned conversations. When false, they only recommend without executing.

report_format.description: Output format for generated reports and summaries.

show_ids.description: Display internal UUIDs alongside human-readable names. Useful for debugging or API work.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for timestamps in reports and triage output.
